component.name: Tablet Center
component.summary: Settings app and daemon for Wacom pen tablets on GNOME (Wayland)

description.p: Tablet Center is a settings app and a small daemon for Wacom pen tablets on GNOME (Wayland). It adds features the Linux driver lacks, starting with pan scroll as it works on macOS.

Features include pan scroll, pen gestures, on-screen shortcuts (Express menu, Radial menu, App shortcuts, Keypad), pen button configuration, tip feel pressure curves, display mapping, ExpressKeys, and more.
Pre-release with Flatpak bundle support, host integration, and Linux Wayland pen tablet enhancements.
